title: Systems-level regulation principles for microbial lignin valorization.
authors: Zhang, Jie; Li, Na; Chen, Hong-Yu; Li, Bing-Zhi; Liu, Zhi-Hua
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦微生物木质素利用的代谢与转录因子调控策略，虽提及转录因子和机器学习，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Lignin, the most abundant renewable source of aromatic carbon, holds strong potential for sustainable biomanufacturing. However, the complexity of lignin-derived aromatic compounds from depolymerization imposes significant challenges on the metabolic regulation of cell factories, thereby limiting efficient biological conversion. This review provides the systems-level regulation principles that enable microbial lignin valorization, covering metabolic regulation in microbial cell factories, transcription factor-based regulation, and dynamic biosensor-based regulation. Synthetic biology tools collectively enhance metabolic flux distribution and pathway robustness. Transcription factor engineering enables coordinated multi-gene regulation and improves microbial adaptability to diverse aromatic substrates. Dynamic engineering strategies provide precise, real-time metabolic control. Overall, these regulatory strategies form an integrated framework for improving the robustness, responsiveness, and overall efficiency of lignin-bioconversion cell factories. Looking ahead, the convergence of machine-learning-guided design, systems-level flux reprogramming, and multi-layer regulatory integration is expected to accelerate the development of efficient, adaptive, and industrially scalable lignin valorization platforms.
abstract_zh: 木质素作为最丰富的可再生芳香碳来源，在可持续生物制造方面具有巨大潜力。然而，解聚产生的木质素衍生芳香族化合物的复杂性，对细胞工厂的代谢调控构成了重大挑战，从而限制了高效的生物转化。本综述提供了实现微生物木质素增值的系统级调控原理，涵盖微生物细胞工厂中的代谢调控、基于转录因子的调控以及基于动态生物传感器的调控。合成生物学工具共同增强了代谢通量分布和途径稳健性。转录因子工程能够实现协调的多基因调控，并提高微生物对多种芳香底物的适应性。动态工程策略提供了精确、实时的代谢控制。总体而言，这些调控策略形成了一个集成框架，用于提高木质素生物转化细胞工厂的稳健性、响应性和整体效率。展望未来，机器学习引导的设计、系统级通量重编程和多层调控整合的融合，有望加速开发高效、适应性强且工业可扩展的木质素增值平台。
